title: Delegation
description: Signed authorization from a Principal to an Agent. Transported as the payload of a JWS (JWT). The issuer_signature field is NOT part of the signed payload — it IS the JWS signature wrapping this object.

delegation_id.description: Unique ID for this delegation. Used for revocation lookups and audit trails.

principal_id.description: Resolvable identifier of the principal (registry-issued ID or DID in later phases).

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent receiving authority.

agent_public_key.description: JWK of the agent's own signing key. Bound to this delegation.

status_endpoint.description: URL a Verifier calls to check current revocation status of delegation_id.

can_delegate.description: Whether the Agent may issue a narrower sub-delegation to another Agent.

max_delegation_depth.description: Only meaningful if can_delegate is true. Caps remaining chain length.

parent_delegation_id.description: Set only on sub-delegations. Points to the delegation this one narrows.

metadata.description: Optional, non-authoritative. Purpose, human explanation, policy URI, etc.
